enabled.name: Enable bridge theme
enabled.hint: Master switch. When off, Carolingian UI's scene navigation and combat tracker revert to their own colours. Dorako UI is unaffected either way.

forceLightScheme.name: Force light color scheme
forceLightScheme.hint: Sets this client's Foundry color scheme to light for both applications and interface, to match Dorako's dnd5e2-light theme. Affects only you, and you can change it back in Foundry's own settings.

setup.menuHint: Configures Carolingian UI and Dorako UI so they stop overlapping: Dorako themes sheets, chat and windows, while Carolingian keeps its scene navigation and combat tracker.
setup.title: Apply recommended setup
setup.intro: This will change the following settings so the two modules stop competing for the same elements:
setup.note: Carolingian's scene navigation and combat tracker settings are left alone — those are the features being kept. Turning off its sheet styling also restores Pathfinder 2e's own item rarity colours.
setup.done: Recommended setup applied. {changed} setting(s) changed, {skipped} already correct.
setup.failed: {count} setting(s) could not be changed — see the console (F12) for details. World-scoped settings require GM permission.
setup.reloadBody: Carolingian UI and Dorako UI both apply their themes at load, so a reload is needed for these changes to take full effect.

notifications.missing: Dorako UI + Carolingian Bridge needs these modules installed and active: {modules}. The bridge will not do anything until they are.
notifications.schemeFailed: Dorako UI + Carolingian Bridge could not set your Foundry colour scheme to light, so everything will render dark. Dorako's dnd5e2 theme follows Foundry's own light/dark setting. Set Configure Settings → Core → Colour Scheme to Light manually. ({detail})
